answer_1.quote: The task of generating a summary to accompany a chart is an instance of data-to-text generation ...
answer_1.outputs: Natural language summaries (chart summaries) describing the content of the chart

answer_2.quote: We evaluate using BLEU , ROUGE-2 , perplexity, and NUBIA ...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a detailed human evaluation, comparing T5-S-OL ... We evaluate the following: (1) Value Correctness (VC): Numbers/values in the summary are from the chart, (2) Outside Information Presence (OIP): The summary contains information not grounded in the chart, (3) Informativeness (Inf): The summary conveys a lot of information about the chart, (4) Coherence (Coh): The summary content is orderly and logically consistent, (5) Fluency (Flu): The text is grammatically correct and is not repetitive. ... We used Prolific to recruit English native speakers ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated summary on five criteria: Value Correctness, Outside Information Presence, Informativeness, Coherence, and Fluency.
